overview: Tag is a compact, non-interactive label for a status or category.

default.title: Default
default.text: The default appearance keeps the existing Tag colors and geometry.

highlight.title: Highlight
highlight.text: Highlight emphasizes a short label with its stronger type treatment.

translucent.title: Translucent
translucent.text: Translucent uses a token color at 24% opacity and is intended for colored surfaces. Do not use it on white backgrounds.

api.intro: Tag renders a concise label as static content. Use its controls to choose an appearance, type, size, and icon.
api.appearance: Visual treatment for the default variant. `default` preserves the standard appearance; `translucent` uses a token color at 24% opacity on colored surfaces, not white backgrounds. Highlight does not accept this prop.
api.children: Text content displayed by the Tag.
api.className: Additional class name applied to the Tag root.
api.icon: Optional custom React element used as the Tag icon.
api.size: Tag size. Translucent appearance uses medium size.
api.type: Status or category color and icon style for the Tag.
api.variant: Tag type treatment: default or highlight.

platforms.text: These examples use the current default Tag API in each code sample.

tokens.intro: The table below lists the Ocean tokens used by the Tag styles.

rules: Keep the label concise and understandable without color alone.
Use Translucent only on colored surfaces, never on white backgrounds.
